name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-06-23, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
